checkpoints.description: [6/6] Verification follow-up: reroll keeps chest/shrine luck and charges nothing when the pool is empty, held R cannot multi-spend, room damage only counts inside a locked room, last chest after the boss still claims the floor bonus, Flow meter no longer shifts the HUD when idle, objective line throttled to 5 Hz; 76 tests green, 7/7 gates, Playwright confirms idle flow, single-charge reroll, post-boss chest claim, pause summary and map. checklists: passed

[1/5] Plan: expand to 10 sections with 4 new biomes and 12 new enemies; add a Sanctuary hub where expeditions start, echoes bank, and restorations rebuild the place; unlock section checkpoints (sections 1/4/7/10); add two-step upgrade confirmation

impact_assessment.why: the game ends after 6 sections, gains are run-only, there is nowhere to rest or spend them, and one click in a level-up can commit the wrong card
impact_assessment.benefits: more late-game variety, a persistent hub loop tied to the lore of rebuilding the sanctuary, checkpoint-based retries, and misclick-safe upgrade picks
impact_assessment.risks: contract: Meta schema, AppState, Screens API, content data and enemy rosters; dependency: none; concurrency: single-threaded; state: new meta fields must default for existing saves and run snapshots must stay v1-compatible
impact_assessment.mitigation: add zod defaults and migration tests, keep hub logic pure and seeded, verify every screen in Playwright, and run the full gate triad

checkpoints.description: [5/5] Implemented and verified: 10 sections (ash, abyss, frost, bloom added), 12 new enemies with tints and 4 new bosses, larger late waves and section-roster summons; Sanctuary hub with 7 restorations bought with banked echoes, paid Rest for saved expeditions, 4 checkpoints (sections 1/4/7/10) with vestige starts; misclick-safe upgrade confirm (click/1-3 select, confirm/second click/Enter/B), HUD and docs relabelled to sections. 88 tests, 7/7 gates, Playwright at 1280x720 and 1024x640. checklists: passed

[6/6] Verification: 104 tests green, lint/typecheck/build and 7/7 project gates; Playwright asserts 12 sections (all biomes/layouts/bosses), sanctuary labels/title, NPC accept+claim, relic equip/swap/discard, barrel+lever, quest reward, boss attack events (mortar/blast/beam/spiral) and zero console errors. Screenshots captured but this model cannot view images. checklists: passed

[5/6] Arsenal + content pass: three weapon stances with distinct combos/animations/effects; bombs (bounce, fuse, chain, friendly fire) and placeable traps; 14 sections with hive/catacomb, 14 biomes, 38 mobs incl. bombardiers, 14 bosses incl. Hive Queen/Bone Tyrant with unique art; bomb/swarm/hook/quake attacks; diamond/cross layouts; Training Yard, Meditation Stone, Notice Board, Warden/Lamplighter, 5 quests and quest log; supply inventory; 24 lore fragments/8 cores; HUD weapon+supplies; README/docs/ADR-020. 114 tests, 7/7 gates, Playwright verified stance switching, bomb/trap, bomber, quests, training/meditation, inventory, hive/catacomb bosses, zero console errors. checklists: passed

[6/6] Visual QA via free vision subagents: confirmed boss/theme fit; fixed stacked banners and duplicate HUD titles, per-stance player attack sheets (sword/spear/greatsword), world-label bleed and clipping, too-transparent hub panels, trap self-trigger; fixed a critical Hive no-boss soft-lock via connected cell linking + guaranteed guardian. 115 tests, 7/7 gates, re-review confirmed FIXED. checklists: passed

[6/6] Second visual QA pass via free vision subagents across title/memories/settings/controls/victory/death/HUD/map/pause, 1024x640 HUD, new mobs and all new attack telegraphs. Fixed: pause chip clipping + unknown-upgrade crash fallback, small-screen minimap/boss-bar/hint collisions, key/setting contrast, telegraph truthfulness (warm spiral, player-centered mines, 4-circle quake, boss-to-player hook, tapered beam). Re-review confirmed all FIXED. 115 tests, 7/7 gates. checklists: passed

[6/6] Direct image inspection (main agent vision) of 40+ screens: fixed attack arcs behind the player, replaced ten identical sanctuary plinths with dedicated station/NPC props, compacted the hall, proximity labels (62-200px) stop edge clipping/title collisions, biome-specific start-room props (cog pillar/ice spire/coral/brazier/comb/bone pile), redrew dark bone/comb/armory art, delayed checkpoint toast clear of banners, and fixed Training/Meditation/Notice prompts. 115 tests, 7/7 gates, direct screenshots confirm. checklists: passed

[1/6] Plan: crisp boss art (192px nearest); per-stance held weapon models; boss-only arena episodes between levels; non-rectangular room shapes; more room types; more mobs/attacks/fight mechanics; surprise events; filled sanctuary with furniture/items

impact_assessment.why: bosses render blurry, stances share silhouettes, rooms are all rectangles, mobs repeat, and the sanctuary still reads as an empty grid
impact_assessment.benefits: sharper art, readable weapon identity, pacing spikes with boss episodes, varied room geometry, richer combat and a lived-in hub
impact_assessment.risks: contract: atlas frame sizes, player animation keys, FloorPlan/room kinds, save schema for episodes/surprises; dependency: none; concurrency: single-threaded; state: new room kinds must not break reachability or objectives
impact_assessment.mitigation: regenerate assets deterministically, keep boss episodes as standalone floors, stress-test layouts and gates, verify each new screen/image directly

checkpoints.description: [6/6] Implemented: 192px nearest-filtered bosses; per-stance idle/walk/attack weapon models; 16 sections incl two boss-only Echo Trials (1.5x health, solo octagon arenas); arena/library room types + rounded/octagon/cave room shapes; weapon art (V) with cooldowns; grave hound/void cantor; deep caster beam/hook, skirmisher bombs, volatile deaths, room ambushes; sanctuary furniture (shelves/tables/chairs/crates/planters/barrels/lanterns) and library decor; archive prompt/fragment. 118 tests, 7/7 gates, direct image review. checklists: passed

Fixed shape carving/islands, library archive prompt, hound model, weapon art, sanctuary furniture. 118 tests, 7/7 gates, cleanup done. checklists: passed
